headline: DOJ moves to forfeit $1.17 billion in USDC stolen in the Binance hack

scenes.vo: Federal prosecutors just moved to claw back over one billion dollars stolen in the Binance hack. Here's what changed.
On Monday, the Justice Department filed to forfeit about one point one seven billion in USDC, held at thirty six addresses on eighteen blockchains.
Here's why traders are watching it. Circle froze those coins, and will issue the same amount of new USDC to the government if a court approves.
The catch? About six billion was stolen on October twenty ninth. The government says about two point nine billion has been frozen, seized or returned so far.
Here's what happens next. Watch the court's ruling on the forfeiture, and whether more of the stolen funds get frozen.
